title: morongia
intro: Morongia, commonly known as the Morongia citriodora, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae, which is native to tropical regions. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms associated with gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Morongia include its use in traditional medicine as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal agent, making it effective in treating various health conditions. Bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids have been identified in Morongia, contributing to its medicinal properties.
